about_the_game:
Hello Survivors! We want to make MISERY affordable to as many players as possible and set a fair price based on your feedback during playtests.

The Zaslavie Supporter Edition is for those who wish to go the extra mile to support the team. This edition includes a beautiful WHITE FUR USHANKA HAT as a token of appreciation. It does not give you any in-game advantages and is not required to have the full experience of MISERY, but it just looks badass.

To get the White Ushanka, when in a bunker, go to Settings > Game and hit the "Receive the Hat" button.

Za Zaslavie!
